name: Tomato-Peach Spaghetti with Arugula, Olives, Almonds & Goat Cheese

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. (Reserve ¾-cup cooking water before draining and set aside.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
425 g spaghetti pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
6 peaches
1 ½ small pkgs grape tomatoes
1 small pkg fresh basil
1 ½ (142 g) pkg baby arugula

instructions.primary_message: Quarter peaches lengthwise (around the pit); twist quarters to separate, then remove and discard pits. Medium dice, place in a medium bowl, and set aside.
Peel, halve, and small dice onions; peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium red onions
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Preheat another large pot over medium heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add onion and garlic. Cook, stirring frequently, until starting to soften, 3-4 minutes.
Add peaches, tomatoes, vinegar, and spices to the pot; continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until peaches soften and tomatoes start to burst, 4-5 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp balsamic vinegar
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper
¼ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, roughly chop olives and place in the reserved bowl.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add half to the bowl with the olives. (Set remaining basil aside for serving.)
Add pasta, reserved pasta water, olives, basil, and almonds to the pot; continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce has thickened slightly, 2-3 minutes more.
Add arugula to the pot in handfuls, waiting for the arugula to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls and crumble goat cheese over top. Garnish with reserved basil and enjoy!
